routine.name: love-tap improvement loop
known_limits: A fired session has no MCP tools at all -- no GitHub tools, no Routine tools. Everything is plain git over HTTPS. A firing therefore cannot change the Routine's own schedule, so the terminal-state step in docs/LOOP.md that drops the cron to weekly has to be recorded in asks[] instead of done.

The Routine stores no repository source, so a fired session may start with no checkout. The prompt's step 0 finds or clones it; if that fails the firing reports it rather than improvising, and the fix is for the owner to attach the repo to the Routine.
